title: Simplify Rerun 3D camera view
objective: Update the programmatic flashlight Rerun example so the 3D camera entity only carries the RGB camera image, while depth, normals, and albedo are logged to separate non-camera image paths to avoid confusing false-color planes in the 3D view.
instructions: Edit examples/flashlight/run_programmatic_rerun.py only unless a very small README update is necessary; keep the change focused.
In log_rerun_frame, keep camera transform and pinhole at spear/camera and keep RGB at spear/camera/rgb.
Move depth_meters, world_normal, and diffuse_color/albedo logging out from under spear/camera to separate paths such as spear/images/depth_meters, spear/images/world_normal, and spear/images/albedo.
Keep camera position, trajectory, light direction, and light status in world/3D-friendly paths.
If README currently says modalities are under spear/ hierarchy, update wording only if needed to avoid doc drift.
Run syntax check and a stubbed Rerun log smoke check if possible.
constraints: Do not redesign the script or change capture behavior.
definition_of_done: 3D camera path carries RGB only; false-color/depth modalities are no longer children of spear/camera.
